projectSnapshot.script: Ever wonder why coffee makes you feel superhuman? It all starts with a molecule called adenosine. Throughout the day, adenosine builds up in your brain, telling you it is time to sleep. But caffeine is a master of disguise. It mimics adenosine and wedges itself into your brain's receptors, blocking the 'sleepy' signals. Your brain stays alert, your focus sharpens, and you are ready to conquer the day. That is the science of your morning brew.

youtubeMetadata.description: Ever wonder why that morning cup of coffee makes you feel like a new person? It isn't magic, it is neurochemistry. In this video, we break down how caffeine hacks your brain to keep you alert. Chapters: 0:00 The Adenosine Block, 0:10 The Brain Chemistry Hack, 0:20 Your Energy Explained. #coffee #science #caffeine #brainhealth #productivity #neuroscience
